reference.configuration: Samson 1917 / Orfey-group reference for the catalog Novik-series aggregate: three funnels, four single 102 mm guns (one forward, three aft), and three triple 450 mm torpedo mounts. This deliberately uses the nine-tube series arrangement, not the original four-funnel Novik with eight tubes. Later AA changes and subclass-specific minor fittings are simplified.
reference.note: Stylized class interpretation guided by catalog dimensions, armament and the linked recognition reference; not an engineering plan or exact reconstruction. Continuous hull/deck surfaces, shaped housings and round fittings are original polygon interpretations of the same documented stations.
